mapper.select: SELECT order_id FROM ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base WHERE now() > period_of_validity AND virtual_goods = 0 AND is_cancel = 1 AND order_refund_status = 0 AND order_refund_status = 0 AND order_status NOT IN ( 1, 7)
select buyer_user_id as buyerUserId, order_payment_amount as orderPaymentAmount from ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base where order_id = #{orderId}
mapper.update: update ${database.prefix.order}hou_order_base set order_finished_time = now(), order_status = 12, is_cancel = 2, order_last_return_time = now() where order_id = #{order}
